w.en: respite would have been granted to them
they will be made to stand
so that you bring to them
So were you to send them away
so (there is) a place of dwelling
and that We (may) make it clear
w.bn: এবং যেন আমরা স্পষ্ট বর্ণনা করি তা

w.en: and so that they may be pleased with it
w.bn: এবং যেন তাতে তারা পরিতুষ্ট হয়

w.en: and so that they may commit
so that they dispute with you
so that they may ruin them

w.bn: আবার ছোট আকারের পশু (যেমন ছাগল, ভেড়া)

w.en: so that He may test you
